{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Tailored trousers, straight leg, full length to the ankle bone, charcoal grey (#3A3D42), fine wool crepe
Fine-gauge knit sweater, slim fit with a crew neck, hip length, ivory (#F1EBDD), merino wool
Single-breasted blazer, tailored fit, hip length, navy (#1F2A44), textured wool tweed
Ankle boots, low block heel, almond toe, dark brown (#4A3426), waterproof smooth leather
Trench coat, belted, knee length, camel (#B98B5A), water-repellent cotton gabardine
Compact umbrella, black (#111111), sturdy canopy
Leather tote bag, structured, medium size, dark brown (#4A3426), grained leather
Thin scarf, soft drape, muted burgundy (#6E2B3A), lightweight wool

This outfit suits a client meeting in a café because the neat tailored trousers, textured blazer and refined knit give a classic, composed look that fits the business-neat level. The restrained palette of charcoal, ivory and navy feels calm and understated, with burgundy adding a quiet touch of warmth. The waterproof boots, water-repellent trench and umbrella keep her dry through a day of autumn rain, and the cool weather is covered by the layered wool and knit. Everything is comfortable to sit in over a long coffee conversation while still looking polished."}
